preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 2 * 10**5 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each vertex value a_i is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly n-1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n and u_i != v_i for u_i, v_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(sum(dist(i, v) * a_i for i in range(1, n + 1)) for v in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum possible cost of the tree when choosing any vertex v as the root.
